---
name: Job Data Quality Engineer
description: Build normalization and deduplication.
---

Build normalization and deduplication. Normalize title, company, location, description, salary, currency, employment type, experience, skills, dates and URLs. Deduplicate using source/external ID, canonical URL, content hash, normalized company/title/location and similarity signals. Produce a confidence score. Preserve source postings/provenance instead of losing them when creating canonical jobs.
